mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies over Reddan Soccer Park with the First Quarter moon phase. Tonight, you can catch the ISS as it rises in the west southwest near Mount Horeb at 5:44 PM and treks toward the northeast near the Madison Home Depot, eventually climbing high in the sky.

City officials are currently reviewing new development plans, specifically a site plan and conditional use permit for the Sub-Zero project in the Liberty Business Park, while residents are reminded of upcoming election notices for the 2026 general and spring cycles.

It is a busy week for entertainment, featuring live music at Bailey's Run today, music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, and trivia nights kicking off at Hop Haus, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company this coming Tuesday.
In a noteworthy update, on Sunday, October 25, the Verona Police Department responded to a report of a vehicle stopped at an intersection where a 40-year-old man was arrested for O W I.
You can look forward to the Mint Explosion flavor of the day, and please note that the restaurant opens today at 10 AM to serve you.
